accuracy_notice: BETA: the models are loadable and deterministic, but word/character level timing has NOT been accepted against a human reference. INT8 timelines differ from FP32 by about 0.12-0.17 s (en/ja) and about 0.02 s (zh) on real songs. Do not advertise per-word precision.

en.engine_notes: Android implements CTC Viterbi itself (blank=0), matching src/autosync/alignment/ctc.py::forced_align. No CTC code is shipped.

input.name: input_values

accuracy.provenance: check-counts from android_export/en/REPORT.md (beta.2 recipe, unchanged in beta.4)
accuracy.notes: MAE is INT8-vs-FP32 consistency, NOT accuracy against a human reference. INT8 shifts CTC boundaries by about 0.12 s on real songs; see android_export/en/QUANTIZATION_NOTES.md.

zh.engine_notes: Non-CTC: the model takes audio + text and emits per-token us_alphas / us_peaks. Android implements ts_prediction_lfr6_standard (TIME_RATE 0.02 s, force_time_shift -1.5, START_END_THRESHOLD 5, MAX_TOKEN_DURATION 12); reference: android_export/zh/postprocess_reference.py.

input.name: input_values
input.preprocessing: raw 16k mono PCM in [-1,1]; fbank+LFR+CMVN baked into the graph

text.normalization: NFKC -> keep only CJK/kana/digits; Latin is dropped by design (src/autosync/lyrics/normalize.py::normalize_cjk)

accuracy.provenance: check-counts from android_export/zh/REPORT.md (beta.2 recipe, unchanged in beta.4)
accuracy.notes: fp32 timestamps are exact against the FunASR engine; INT8 is inside the 20 ms MAE gate but the worst single token is 1340 ms. us_peaks uses a closed-form cumsum/floor substitute for cif_wo_hidden (max|delta| 12) - an open contract deviation.

ja.engine_notes: Phoneme-level CTC (blank=PAD=0) over a 48-token phoneme inventory. Android must implement (a) G2P to phonemes, (b) the char<->phoneme mapper (ja_pronunciation.py / map_spans_to_char_units), (c) CTC Viterbi. The model itself has NO baked normalisation.

input.name: input_values
input.preprocessing: raw 16k mono PCM in [-1,1]; NO external normalization (preprocessor do_normalize=false; HuBERT uses internal group norm)

text.normalization: NFKC -> pyopenjtalk G2P to phonemes (Latin is read letter-by-letter); see g2p_dependency

accuracy.provenance: All figures name their model revision and evaluation corpus. 'real_music' = Test/ full-mix songs via benchmarks/quant_selective_eval.py (INT8 vs FP32 consistency, NOT human accuracy). 'gtsinger' = a-cappella held-out corpus via benchmarks/onnx_quant_eval.py (absolute vs human boundaries). 'blind' = a song already used for selection in an earlier version; reported for continuity only, not as a fresh test.
accuracy.model_recipe: dynamic QInt8, per-channel, MatMul/Gemm; attention of encoder layer 8 kept FP32
accuracy.note: beta.4 JA: keeping encoder layer 8's attention in FP32 makes the model both smaller (129.4 vs 164.7 MB) and more consistent than beta.3. android_export/ja/REPORT.md still documents the beta.2 recipe and was not regenerated for this variant.

g2p_dependency.recommended: bundle OpenJTalk + NAIST dictionary and call it via JNI
g2p_dependency.openjtalk_code_license: MIT (pyopenjtalk); modified BSD (NAIST) for the dictionary
g2p_dependency.note: The dictionary is NOT part of this pack. If Android bundles it, it must reproduce the NAIST copyright notice and disclaimer. The HTS voice (mei_normal.htsvoice) is synthesis-only and must not be shipped for G2P.
